why: The definitions agree. The project's IsScSmoothSection (fst_eq on O plus Definition 2.7 in the 'every retraction onto O' form) is B's IsScSmoothSectionB (f(O) ⊆ K, (f x).1 = x, Definition 2.7 with one retraction) because O = r(U) is a retract (baseRetraction, after converting B's strong bundle retraction); the project's IsScPlusSection, stated for the lift f₁ : E₀ → E₀ × F₁, is B's sc⁺-section via f = (f₁.1, ι f₁.2), where B's requirement f(O) ⊆ K is exactly IsScPlusSection.mem (used from A); the principal-part identity is immediate. B ⇒ A fails for a genuine (if small) reason: B only compares definitions, in the setting O = r(U), K = R(U ◁ F); A's IsScPlusSection.mem is stated for arbitrary C, O, K, and IsScPlusSection.isScSmoothSection (an sc⁺-section is sc-smooth, via the sc-smooth inclusion K[1] → K[0]) is not asserted by B at all. Both facts are true; B just does not contain them.
